properties.name: grails.views.json.mimeTypes
properties.description: MIME types handled by JSON views.

properties.name: grails.views.json.generator.escapeUnicode
properties.description: Whether to escape Unicode characters in JSON output.

properties.name: grails.views.json.generator.dateFormat
properties.description: A SimpleDateFormat pattern for java.util.Date and Calendar values in JSON views. When not set, they are written the same way as Spring Boot writes them: a UTC instant with millisecond precision, such as 2024-06-15T14:30:45.123Z.

properties.name: grails.views.json.generator.timeZone
properties.description: The time zone that java.util.Date and Calendar values are written in: with their offset, as Spring Boot's spring.jackson.time-zone does, or with the grails.views.json.generator.dateFormat pattern when one is set.

properties.name: grails.views.json.generator.locale
properties.description: The locale for the grails.views.json.generator.dateFormat pattern.

properties.name: grails.views.json.compileStatic
properties.description: Whether JSON views are statically compiled.

properties.name: grails.views.json.encoding
properties.description: The character encoding for JSON views.

properties.name: grails.views.json.prettyPrint
properties.description: Whether to pretty-print JSON output with indentation.

properties.name: grails.views.json.allowResourceExpansion
properties.description: Whether to allow HAL resource expansion in JSON views.

properties.name: grails.views.json.baseTemplateClass
properties.description: The base template class for JSON Views.

properties.name: grails.views.json.cache
properties.description: Whether to cache compiled JSON View templates. Defaults to false in development and true otherwise.

properties.name: grails.views.json.enableReloading
properties.description: Whether JSON Views are reloaded when they change. Defaults to true in development and false otherwise.

properties.name: grails.views.json.extension
properties.description: The file extension for JSON View templates.

properties.name: grails.views.json.packageImports
properties.description: Packages imported into JSON View templates.

properties.name: grails.views.json.packageName
properties.description: The package name used for compiled JSON Views. Defaults to the application name.

properties.name: grails.views.json.staticImports
properties.description: Static classes imported into JSON View templates.

properties.name: grails.views.json.templatePath
properties.description: The filesystem path containing JSON View templates. Defaults to the environment reload location or application views directory.

properties.name: grails.views.json.useAbsoluteLinks
properties.description: Whether links generated by JSON Views use absolute URLs.
